set.body:
Add a shared analysis-level module that replaces fmrireg formula/job/preflight surfaces with typed immutable values: AnalysisPlan, DatasetRecipe, SubjectJob, PreflightReport, ContrastWorkflow, GroupWorkflow, and ResultBundle references.

Acceptance: jobs are serializable recipes, not captured environments; preflight reports all structural issues without loading voxel payloads unless requested; plans can fan out over subjects through chunk/pipeline interpreters; BIDS and JVM IO stay at adapter boundaries.
set.title: Create typed analysis/job/preflight DSL
